tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java & E-Commerce Platforms
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce platform experience building and scaling SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, and API integrations. Proven expertise in data pipelines, CI/CD deployments, performance optimization, and agile delivery across international teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Salesforce Developer - Commerce Cloud
cover_en.hook: KCS IT's commitment to international enterprise innovation and collaborative values makes this Commerce Cloud Developer role an ideal match for my background. With over 5 years of specialized e-commerce platform engineering experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in Java, RESTful APIs, and enterprise integrations.

bullets.label: Commerce Cloud & Enterprise Platforms
bullets.text: Designed and implemented robust backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, managing complex product catalogs, pricing, and customer structures.

bullets.label: APIs & Integrations
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs, alongside custom Interceptors, Populators, and Converters for seamless third-party and PIM/ERP data flows.

bullets.label: Cloud Deployment & CI/CD
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) within agile DevOps workflows, ensuring high platform availability.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery
bullets.text: Collaborated closely with international technical teams and business stakeholders in Scrum environments, translating requirements into scalable enterprise solutions.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, requiring no sponsorship. I am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, making me available to start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my enterprise e-commerce expertise can add value to KCS IT.

tailoring.why_company: KCS IT stands out for its strong commitment to dedication, flexibility, and collaborative value creation across international projects. I am eager to contribute my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce and API integration expertise to your dynamic consulting environment, supporting robust platform implementations for global clients.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of enterprise commerce platform engineering, Java, REST APIs, and robust integration experience to KCS IT's international projects.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, and API integration experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am very interested in KCS IT's Commerce Cloud Developer role. I hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16.12.2026. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Salesforce Developer - Commerce Cloud - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Salesforce Developer - Commerce Cloud position at KCS IT. With over five years of specialized experience building enterprise e-commerce platforms, Java backends, RESTful APIs, and complex integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am well-equipped to contribute to your international projects.

I hold a valid German work permit and am available to start on 16.12.2026 following my notice period.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
